description: Get Leads in a List - Retrieve all leads/contacts in a specific list. Supported filters: search, archived, sort, sequence, status.

archived.description: Filter by archived status (truthy only; false is unreliable)

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return (max 100)

list_id.description: The list ID to get leads from

search.description: Search query to filter leads by name/email

skip.description: Number of leads to skip for pagination

status.description: Filter by lead status (not_contacted, contacted, opened, clicked, replied, bounced, unsubscribed). Works with or without `sequence`; without it, the status matches across all sequences (e.g. replied = replied in any sequence). Omit to return the full list.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_leads

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get Leads
